ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low macro-level contrast; approximately 0.03:0.97 ratio of high-intensity white pixels (concentrated in scars and edge spray) to low-intensity black pixels across the monolithic dark fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly uniform dark pigmentation; sparse, non-contiguous white pixel clusters (focal spots) are mapped to the distal medial region of the right lobe and along the extreme trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 42 degrees and a bounding-box depth of roughly 12% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe exhibits high-amplitude, irregular jagged peaks and a significant deep indentation (notch) at the mid-trailing edge. Right lobe displays a higher frequency of low-amplitude, fine-grained serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Moderate concave curvature originating from the median notch and extending towards the lateral tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast white pixel clusters, varying from 3 to 10 pixels in diameter, localized on the medial-distal surface of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct network of unaligned, high-intensity white linear streaks (rake marks) oriented diagonally across the right lobe surface, breaking the dark pigment continuity.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular truncation/chipping of the trailing edge on the left lobe, indicating substantial physical trauma or predatory interaction marks.
other_distinctive_markers: High-density concentration of linear white scarring on the right lobe surface contrasting sharply against the nearly featureless dark pigment of the left lobe surface.
